base.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production source artwork for a 32x32 tile cozy fantasy academy dorm room, EMPTY room base, landscape 4:3 aspect 1536x1152.
Reference images 1 and 2: STYLE references only, MagicCampus room and journal illustrations. Capture their warm honey wood, cream plaster, dark wood trim, tiny gold motifs, refined clustered pixel-readable detail. Do not copy UI or furniture.
Primary request: an empty rectangular dorm room shown in straight front-facing elevated orthographic RPG view, looking down at 30 degrees, all verticals exactly vertical, horizontal edges exactly horizontal, no isometric rotation. Interior is a flat rectangular 12 columns by 9 rows game map; floor dominates lower 75 percent. Straight rear wall across top with cream plaster and honey wood wainscot, simple side wall trims at extreme left and right, front wall cut away. Bottom-center front doorway opening lies in column 5 (zero based, so slightly left of exact center), no actual door obstruction; clean wood threshold. EMPTY open honey oak plank floor over the entire interior, regular horizontal planks with restrained staggered seams and subtle wear. NO window, furniture, rugs, plants, characters, lamps, hanging decorations, objects, exposed rafters over floor, or perspective taper. Base will be cropped for reusable floor/wall tiles, so clear uninterrupted texture regions. No visible grid or writing. Soft neutral ambient light with very subtle local crevice occlusion only, absolutely NO sunlight, rays, bright window shapes, directional shadows, cast shadows or vignette. Warm inviting handcrafted fantasy academy style, controlled fine material detail, readable shapes, no photographic grain. Full rectangular room with no black background, no external scenery, no text, no UI, no watermark.
